text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear three-part structure with transitions like \"First of all,\" \"Second,\" and \"Additionally,\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a clear sequence and uses transitions to guide the reader through its points."},{"evidence":"more varied sentence patterns and longer developed paragraphs","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay develops each reason with supporting detail and examples rather than repeating the same statement pattern."},{"evidence":"specific examples like \"taking a test,\" \"doodle on my notes,\" and \"2D and 3D animation\"","quality":"concrete support","description":"The essay uses relevant examples to explain and illustrate its claims."},{"evidence":"mostly understandable phrasing such as \"it makes me less stressed out\" and \"I like trying out new styles\"","quality":"clarity","description":"The essay communicates its ideas more clearly and smoothly, with fewer phrases that impede understanding."},{"evidence":"fewer repeated sentence frames and less repetitive wording","quality":"lexical control","description":"The essay shows stronger command of wording by varying expressions instead of relying heavily on repetition."}]}
